probe.description: Single $1.00 USD sandbox payout to confirm Payouts capability. Not part of the AP-agent demo. No money is real; sandbox only.
probe.name: PAYOUT_NOT_AVAILABLE
probe.message: You live in a country that is not allowed to send this payout.

fullDemo: NOT RUN. bun run paypal:demo -- --live was not started. A live run also requires PAYPAL_SANDBOX_RECEIVER_EMAIL (a Personal sandbox account email), which was not in the env file. The capability probe failed first, so no demo payouts were sent.

why.officialFeatureSet: India is listed as 'Receive and withdraw' only on PayPal Payouts country support — merchants cannot send payouts from India.
why.interpretation: The Default Application's sandbox business account is in a send-ineligible country (India). OAuth and the Payouts scope both succeed; PayPal still rejects create-payout with PAYOUT_NOT_AVAILABLE.

requiredToUnblock: In https://developer.paypal.com/dashboard/accounts create a Sandbox Business account with Country = United States (a send-eligible country).
Create or keep a Sandbox Personal account to receive payouts (India personal accounts can receive; a US personal account also works).
Apps & Credentials (Sandbox) → Create App → type Merchant → attach the US Business sandbox account. Enable Payouts on that app if the dashboard offers the feature toggle.
Replace PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID and PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET in the locked env file with that new app's sandbox credentials. Do not put them in git or chat.
Set PAYPAL_SANDBOX_RECEIVER_EMAIL to the Personal sandbox account email (optional PAYPAL_SANDBOX_RECEIVER_EMAIL_2 for a second payee).
Re-run: set -a; . /home/box/secure/paypal.env; set +a; bun run paypal:demo -- --live --save
redaction: No client secrets, access tokens, or raw credential values are stored in this file.
